t: Car and home pressure washer with a height-adjustable aluminium telescopic handle to ensure a comfortable pulling height. Includes a home kit containing T5 surface cleaner with 3-in-1 stone cleaner, car kit with foam jet, rotating wash brush and shampoo. Also features Quick Connect trigger gun, a 6m high pressure hose, Vario power spray lance and dirt blaster. Area performance of 30m²/h. Ideal for regular cleaning of moderate levels of dirt.
b: 5 Year Manufacturer’s Guarantee (Registration Required, T&Cs Apply)
